steps.en: Obtain UCM and open the checked-in hello transcript
steps.zh: 获取 UCM，打开仓库中的入门记录

steps.en: Run the transcript in a fresh codebase
steps.zh: 在新建代码库中执行记录

steps.en: Typechecks definitions and evaluates transcript commands
steps.zh: 检查定义类型，执行记录中的命令

steps.en: Stores added definitions by content identity and emits annotated output
steps.zh: 按内容身份保存定义，输出带结果的记录

value.en: Code identity and checked examples are managed by the language tooling, not textual names alone
value.zh: 语言工具管理代码身份和已检查示例，不只依赖文本名称
